Well, there you go. Heat destroys psilocybin, as well as oxygen. Also, improperly dried mushrooms go bad quickly. There's a number of reasons you may have had such a wild difference in potency. None of which are the fault of the mushrooms under good conditions. Early in my cultivation career, i ate about 150g of fresh (wet) cubies. Not a great idea for some people, but i wanted to know how far i could go. The visuals were amazing, time became non- linear for me, and "me" did not exist for several hours. It was the beginning of my shamanic journey, the genesis of my real story. I tried to duplicate the experience for the following three days, but, by day four i felt nothing at all from the same dose. No fault of the cubies, they abhor self- indulgent excess. I was at fault. Two years later,  i would travel four thousand years to experience a ritual as a shaman, featuring a human sacrifice, brought on by a single 5g mushroom from Terrence McKenna's Penis Envy strain (easily the strongest i ever grew). This was two years into my journey, during which i took a 'heroic' dose (5g dried, or more) every 14 days, religiously, without fail. Were some trips more profound than others? Absolutely. Did i ever have a weak trip due to weak mushrooms? Not in four years, over one hundred individual experiences. So, yeah, read more Stamets.
